root_cause: Broad GitHub Actions triggers caused unrelated branch pushes and unrelated Supabase migrations to start recovery, revenue and LinkedIn workflows, multiplying queued work while exact-head delivery was already saturated.
prevention_rule: Global recovery supervision runs on main push, schedule or manual dispatch, not every branch push. Domain workflows watch only owned files/migrations. Generic migration-history integrity is verified once in the existing Supabase preview lane instead of re-running heavy revenue suites.
